changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetUrlById] ( @AssetID bigint ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT CASE A.Object WHEN 'Artifact' THEN 'asset/' + CAST(A.Uid as varchar) WHEN 'ReferenceItem' THEN 'assets/' + + CAST(T.uid as varchar) WHEN 'Group' THEN 'group/' + CAST(A.ObjectID as varchar) WHEN 'Policy' THEN 'asset/' + CAST(A.Uid as varchar) WHEN 'Resource' THEN 'users/' + CAST(A.Uid as varchar) WHEN 'Rule' THEN 'asset/' + CAST(A.Uid as varchar) WHEN 'Taxonomy' THEN 'asset/' + CAST(A.Uid as varchar) end as Url from Asset A inner join AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID where A.ID = @AssetID )
